kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: Roosta, Teeth

attribution.author: Roosta, Teeth
attribution.source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/123134 (Key Authors: Roosta, Teeth; submitter Lightning.)

notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf map with no finish (see maps/zones/README.md). 38 placed weapons, jails (jail1, jail2, jailt), a control room and a scout round -- combat. gb-maps-1 batch of 2026-10-09. Not published. The scout round's start-disabled teleports over the spawns are dropped (round_teleports).

round_teleports.note: The scout round's four teleports start disabled over the spawn room and are switched on by the round; this game runs no rounds. Imported, they were pits over every spawn whose destination chain ends in a cycle, so they sent a player to the spawn inside them for ever (headless_mechanics: 'loops').
